name: B3 BRL Stablecoin
oneLiner: BRL-B3 is a pre-launch Brazilian real settlement stablecoin from B3, Latin America's largest stock exchange, designed for its tokenized asset trading platform.
collateral: 1:1 Brazilian Real reserves; designed as settlement layer for B3's tokenized asset trading platform
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed Brazilian-real settlement token for B3's tokenization platform; B3 materials describe it as value-linked to fiat currency and as the real-denominated settlement instrument for tokenized-asset trading
launchPhaseDetail: Latin America's largest stock exchange (B3/Sao Paulo) is developing B3RL, its own BRL settlement stablecoin for tokenized-asset trading. At B3's Tokenization Day (May 26-27 2026), coverage indicated a later-2026 / H2 2026 window for B3RL and the tokenized-asset registry; the prior H1 2026 window has elapsed with no on-chain deployment visible. At Expert XP on July 23-24 2026 B3 placed the launch between August and September 2026, and its Q2 2026 results note (August 11) confirmed infrastructure testing of B3RL had begun, which is the first B3-owned confirmation of the ticker. Backing is expected to be mainly cash and Tesouro Nacional securities; Polygon is cited only in Brazilian press. No deployment was visible as of September 13 2026.

milestones.title: B3 announces BRL stablecoin and tokenization platform
milestones.description: Latin America's largest stock exchange plans a BRL-pegged settlement stablecoin for tokenized asset trading.

milestones.title: B3 Tokenization Day: B3RL stablecoin and tokenized share registry confirmed for H2 2026
milestones.description: B3 confirmed its tokenized share registry and B3RL settlement stablecoin target H2 2026 (slipped from H1 2026); stablecoin to be backed by cash and government bonds.

milestones.title: B3 clarifies B3RL settlement stablecoin targets H1 2026 on Polygon; tokenization platform follows in H2
milestones.description: At Tokenization Day, B3 OTC and digital-assets director Humberto Costa said the B3RL settlement stablecoin, backed by cash and government bonds, built on Polygon, is expected in the first half of 2026, while the tokenized-share registry/tokenizer advances in the second half, disentangling the two timelines that earlier coverage had merged.

milestones.title: B3 director confirms B3RL launches "in the coming months" at Expert XP 2026
milestones.description: Director Felipe Paiva said B3 launches B3RL in the coming months, with asset tokenization to follow in early 2027; corroborated by Jornal do Comércio on July 24.

milestones.title: B3 narrows the B3RL launch window to August-September 2026
milestones.description: Coverage of Expert XP 2026 reports B3 director Felipe Paiva placing the B3RL launch between August and September 2026, with backing mainly in cash and Tesouro Nacional securities and tokenised assets to follow in early 2027.

milestones.title: B3's Q2 2026 results note confirms infrastructure testing of B3RL has begun
milestones.description: B3's own Bora Investir results summary states the company started testing the infrastructure of B3RL, its stablecoin, as a step toward asset tokenisation. It is the first B3-owned source to name the B3RL ticker.
